answer: Trace where rewards flow. Each account's earnings vest for 20 epochs, and if coins from two accounts ever land in the same downstream wallet before vesting ends, both forfeit everything unvested. Honest agents cash out alone and never notice. A Sybil farmer with 500 keys can't sweep them to one haven: each fake needs its own exit and its own off-ramp, and any shared jetty where flows meet becomes a relic on the ledger that claws back the whole fleet's pay.
